scope: Direct visual review of completed current-source JVM Compose outputs before the later PrivateHand control-order correction. No Godot PCK or native runtime is used by these tests.

review_conclusion: The current context-first layout and scrolled hand states are readable, with no new visible overlap or lost private-control semantics in the inspected completed images. Initial natural Reveal visibility remains unfulfilled in the new executed 411 × 662 fixture. The large-text explanatory panel pushes the genuine button beyond the viewport; this finding motivated the separate frozen PrivateHand correction.
limitations: The old fallback image was captured only after explicit ScrollTo.
Current JVM font-scale-2 pixels are not Android nonlinear-font pixel parity.
No existing or new JVM image establishes original Android pre-UP visibility, renderer retirement, or native-held acceptance.
The later PrivateHand correction and its rerun are outside this review; no corrected-layout pass is claimed.
